name: THE HORSES
sceneryNote: Scenery until its lines are written (reference/hitching-post/brief.md): the pointer passes through to the mud under it, so it answers no verb and names nothing. Its LOOK and LISTEN lines go in the documents first; then this goes and a hotspot is laid over it.
note: Tyler, 2026-11-07, on Main Street: "maybe we add a hitching post front and center of the camera with a few horses tied to it so that it's not just a bunch of empty space?" A hitching rail with three saddle horses, in the near mud in front of the trough and the Nugget, between the boundary men and the duel crowd's band. Room-02 attempts 3 and 4.

sprite.statureNote: The rest frame, ear tips to hooves, is 1.06 of the room's man where they stand: their withers come to about Thad's shoulder (0.82 of a man) and the withers are 132 of the 170 rows from the hooves.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 the chestnut noses the mud · 2 the grey looks up, tail swished · 3 all three heads up · 4 a hind hoof rested. At rest on 0; every 7 s one of the four plays for 2.4 s, rotating, so all three heads come up together every 28 s (errata 77).
